summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing an update to its value-up plan, now called 'Shinhan Value-Up +++ (Triple Plus).' This is a voluntary corporate governance and capital allocation framework, not a transaction. The plan sets targets of 10-12% ROE, 50%+ shareholder return ratio, and 13%+ CET1 ratio, with annual reviews. The filing is a routine disclosure of a board-adopted strategic plan, not a special situation event.
